jyutping: A ge3 ji3 si1 hai6 B

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “signify” means that a word, sign, or action means something.

examples.english: This red light can signify that we must stop.
examples.traditional: 呢個紅燈嘅意思係要停低。
